bounds.domain: One correctly wired process-local Maps search observation and one captured receipt, two committed source publications, two symbolic values for each query/area/complete-results/provider/readiness coordinate. Two is a model bound, never a production data or request limit. A separate three-boolean projection covers the existing camera-follow intent. The result-camera projection has one mounted plane, global/regional coverage, an optional host opening, three updates, two distinct complete nonempty pin inputs and an empty input, with free/selected/route/following camera ownership.
bounds.projection: Every committed search source is compared in full before synchronously publishing its revision. The results token abstracts the complete ordered validated Place array; the area is the exact near coordinate admitted with that request, not a later viewport. An unchanged render keeps its revision. Closing the view withdraws its observation. The legacy query-only mutation traces demonstrate rejected area/result omissions. Viewport coordinates remain local except a later explicit user search to the existing provider; the observation envelope exposes no area or search contents. Pin tokens distinguish complete ordered id/longitude/latitude tuples, including delimiter-bearing IDs. Every ready update consumes its input once even when another camera owner suppresses fitting. Opening settings apply only worldwide; regional coverage remains authoritative.
bounds.conformance: The mandatory hook runs exact real controller/plane/generation cases and the entire named React MapsScreen view suite without skips. It checks the actual process-local observation validator against changed areas, changed results and pending replacement reads, plus permission/typed-origin cancellation, retired cleanup, wrapped viewport coordinates, camera gesture/Recenter wiring and phone link boundaries. Providers/GPS/map ports are controlled.
limits: Atomic committed publication and validation are projected; provider I/O, rendering, cross-process scheduling and unbounded source chains are outside this model. Existing search-request/generation owners remain in production; no second owner or store is introduced.

No new liveness or wall-clock claim is made for these synchronous transitions. The model makes no provider availability or fairness assumption. Native cleanup progress retains its existing separate model.

Camera following is a controller intent, not proof of successful MapLibre paint, GPS accuracy, physical navigation or native permission behavior. Actual controlled browser walkthroughs and canonical app audit are separate evidence.
This is a bounded projection with named real implementation conformance, not a semantic refinement proof or proof that every external host forwards the optional plane ports.

Opening coordinates and MapLibre zoom clamping, numeric fit geometry, style-load timing and external host use of initialView are not proven by the finite projection. Owning real-plane checks and controlled real-MapLibre browser evidence qualify those separate boundaries. No provider/GPS availability or animation completion progress is assumed.
